extended_density_contract.black_hole: rho_BH(r)=M_BH*(2*pi*epsilon_BH^2)^(-3/2)*exp(-r^2/(2*epsilon_BH^2)); epsilon_BH equals one finest scientific grid cell and must be halved in the convergence run.
extended_density_contract.grid: Scientific density box extends to at least 22*r_s in each direction; isolated FFT solution uses padding factor 2, repeats at factor 4, then halves cell size at the same physical boundary. Failure of either convergence gate invalidates the score.

pseudo_nfw.density: rho_DM(m)=rho_s*r_s^3/[m*(r_s^2+m^2)]*T(m), evaluated with the cell-integrated central value at m=0
pseudo_nfw.flattening: q_DM in [0.3,1]; halo centre and position angle equal the stellar centre and position angle in the primary comparator
pseudo_nfw.normalization: rho_s is solved linearly so projected dark mass inside the circular cylinder R<=R_E and |z|<=22*r_s is f_DM/(1-f_DM) times projected (stellar+BH) mass in the identical cylinder
pseudo_nfw.scale_radius: r_s=10*R_eff in the primary comparator; registered sensitivity values are 5*R_eff and a log-uniform free r_s/R_eff in [1,30]

extended_density_contract.stellar_ML: Seven luminous Gaussians use six positive mass-to-light parameters because components 1 and 2 are tied. Upsilon_j is monotonically non-increasing with projected Gaussian scale.
extended_density_contract.stellar_luminosity: For luminous Gaussian j, nu_j(R,z)=L_j/((2*pi)^(3/2)*sigma_j^3*q_j)*exp(-(R^2+z^2/q_j^2)/(2*sigma_j^2)); rho_star=sum_j Upsilon_j*nu_j. Each component integrates to Upsilon_j*L_j over R,z.

predictive_likelihood_contract.calibration: Report held-out Mahalanobis distance and randomized quantile residuals per channel. Require the distance inside the 1%-99% chi-square predictive interval and residual absolute mean<=0.25 with variance in [0.5,2].
predictive_likelihood_contract.hst_predictive_density: For draw s, analytically marginalize the linear 80x80 source posterior: D_h|theta_s,D_t ~ Normal(A_h*m_s, C_hh + A_h*Lambda_s*A_h^T), where m_s and Lambda_s are the source mean/covariance conditioned only on training pixels. Evaluate the full normalized multivariate Gaussian log density including log determinant.
predictive_likelihood_contract.metric_not_evidence: No marginal evidence or Bayes factor is claimed. The primary statistic is a fully specified held-out log predictive density difference.
predictive_likelihood_contract.muse_predictive_density: For draw s, form the joint empirical covariance blocks C_tt,C_hh,C_ht. Given training residual r_t=D_t-mu_t(theta_s), D_h|theta_s,D_t ~ Normal(mu_h(theta_s)+C_ht*C_tt^-1*r_t, C_hh-C_ht*C_tt^-1*C_th). Evaluate the full normalized multivariate Gaussian for concatenated held-out (v_los,sigma_los).
predictive_likelihood_contract.posterior_draws: Condition on training sectors only. Use 256-walker affine-invariant MCMC, discard at least 50 integrated autocorrelation times, then retain exactly 4096 equal-weight draws by deterministic stride. Require split-Rhat<=1.01 and bulk ESS>=1000 for every scalar; otherwise invalid.
predictive_likelihood_contract.posterior_predictive_mixture: For channel k, LPD_k=logsumexp_s(log p_k(D_h|theta_s,D_t))-log(4096). Joint LPD=LPD_HST+LPD_MUSE. Delta_LPD is candidate minus GR comparator on the same held-out values.
predictive_likelihood_contract.primary_survival: Delta_LPD_joint>=10, Delta_LPD_HST>=2, Delta_LPD_MUSE>=2, both calibration gates pass, and the equal-tail 99.73% posterior interval for g excludes zero. No threshold may change after array decode.
predictive_likelihood_contract.registered_robustness: Repeat once with sectors rotated by +pi/5. It is reported separately and cannot replace the primary sector result.
predictive_likelihood_contract.sector_assignment: For each valid HST pixel or MUSE bin centre, phi=atan2(Dec-Dec0,(RA-RA0)*cos(Dec0)) mod 2*pi and sector=floor(5*phi/(2*pi)). Sectors 0-3 train; sector 4 is held out. Boundary angles go to the higher numbered sector except 2*pi maps to 0.

shared_state_contract.matter_route: Only Phi enters the axisymmetric Jeans acceleration and projected second moments.
shared_state_contract.photon_route: Only the same Phi+Psi state enters the line-of-sight deflection integral and extended-source ray map with the frozen D_l,D_s,D_ls.
shared_state_contract.primary_comparator: GR_PLUS_STARS_PLUS_TRUNCATED_PSEUDONFW_PLUS_GAUSSIAN_BLACK_HOLE, obtained only by g=0 with the identical density, grids, masks, nuisance priors and likelihood
